_comment: Pulled live from macro_indicators / big_cycle_metrics / big_cycle_stages on 2026-11-16, per Phase 0 of docs/specs/debt-metrics-integrity.md. All values matched the spec's own snapshot list (see decisions log) except where noted.
source: macro_indicators, big_cycle_metrics, big_cycle_stages (live query, not hand-typed)

debt_to_penny_live_2026_11_12.note: tot_pub_debt_out_amt = $40.61T, exact match to the spec's gross-debt snapshot figure.

discrepancies_vs_spec_snapshot: indirect_bidder 'Position Check' 59.3% value not independently re-derived in Phase 0 -- the classifier's own trailing-6 pooled average (classifyDebtCycleStageV2's indirectBidderAvg6) wasn't recomputed from raw auction series within Phase 0's time budget; accepted the spec's stated 59.3 at face value since mp3AuctionDemandWeak's live false reading (needs >=57.5 to be true-safe) is consistent with it.
'gross debt $40.61T' is not itself a macro_indicators/big_cycle_metrics card -- confirmed instead directly from Treasury's debt_to_penny API (tot_pub_debt_out_amt), exact match.

trip-wire 'armed since 2026-02-20' date was not located in a dedicated persistence table within Phase 0's time budget -- no trip_wire-named table exists; likely computed on read or logged in big_cycle_event_scans/big_cycle_events. Flagged for whoever implements Phase 4b (the new fiscal_dominance_confirmed trip-wire) to locate precisely.
